tutorial.texto: Take the ferry in Vermilion to the Competition Center and talk to the clerk at the desk. You need at least 1 Gym Badge. For 2x2, sign up together with your partner.
Choose 6 to 24 Pokémon for the whole night. The reserve stays locked until you are knocked out.
Before every match you pick 6 from your reserve. A different 6 each round is fine.
Everyone can watch the matches, so a big reserve lets you change plans between rounds.
A team can't repeat a species or a held item. Each tournament can add its own rules: check the Rules tab.
Be online and in the Colosseum when your match is called, or you lose by no-show. If time runs out before you pick, your team goes in reserve order.
The final is best of 3: pick 3 teams of 6 from your reserve, one per game. The same Pokémon can be in more than one team.
Spectators can predict who wins each match. Every correct pick gives Fan points.
